The '''Nentan checkpoint base''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] facility located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nentan]]. The base was commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], and served as a stopover point for civilians moving to Alliance [[Safe world/Legends|safe worlds]]. Two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the base went operational, it was discovered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. An [[Battle of Nentan|evacuation]] of the base was ordered, but there were not enough [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to evacuate both civilians and military personnel. With civilians getting priority, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] led a squad of soldiers into the [[Nentan wastes]] where they stole an Imperial [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and escaped the planet.
